scenarios.title: Authenticated cart lifecycle
assertions: add, update quantity, and remove persist

assertions: order ownership and confirmation remain customer-bound

scenarios.title: Customer-safe order lookup

assertions: matching public number and contact return the order
catalog and provider identifiers are absent

scenarios.title: Admin queue and order transitions
assertions: queue is visible and allowed transitions succeed

scenarios.title: Fulfillment and customer tracking
canonicalOwners: staging Playwright admin and guest projects

customer lookup shows tracking without private operational fields

assertions: amounts, currency, and persisted provider key reconcile
refund objects are visible in the attested Stripe account

scenarios.title: Refund duplicate and unknown-outcome handling
canonicalOwners: refund adapter and signed webhook integration

Stripe is reconciled before redispatch and unknown state blocks

scenarios.title: Transactional message delivery

scenarios.title: Cross-service correlation and redaction
fixtures: representative HTTP, webhook, worker, and delivery events

logs and evidence omit forbidden sensitive fields

scenarios.title: Run fixture isolation and cleanup
assertions: identity attestation and run ownership prevent unowned mutation
normal and TTL cleanup verify deletion or terminal isolation
